text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Hokkaido camp, awwwww yissss☆

As promised, during a break in the summer 
training camp, we visited Hokkaido once 
again... and the three of us enjoyed the 
outdoor life for a while.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Teiyah☆ Like this, Palmer-chin? Is this a 
certified god-tier catch? Big fish get!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, probably. Now we just have to stay 
completely still and...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
FuFu~âª Fishing for BFF sweetfish~! 
Char-a-way, yeeeeeeahâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aah, if you make that much noise...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gah, it got away~. Major buzzkill~...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"BBQ☆ BBQ★ And to top it off～ Yakisoba, 
Fuu～!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So yummy~♪ Pal-chin, what's in this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The ingredients are chives, potatoes, and 
stuff. The seasoning's just whatever, too. 
Still, pretty decent, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... subtly delicious? 
Tastes like mom's cooking? I feel like I 
could eat this three times a day and never 
get tired of it☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, that's good. You eat too, Trainer.

The teppan yakisoba made by Mejiro Palmer 
had a very simple, classic flavor. It 
wasn't rustic at all, tasting just like a 
home-cooked meal.

"That's precisely why its unpretentious, 
comforting flavor warmed me all the way 
down to my stomach."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I will enjoy this coffee brewed 
by my bestie...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Blegh, what are these little grains?! 
Helios, this is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Boba coffee♪ In-store riiiight now☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Boba?! Like, you just decided to toss some 
in?! Aahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Our style of camping is totally chaotic, 
but it's actually pretty hype, don'tcha 
think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I might just want to do this for a living 
forever!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, nice one, Palmer-chin☆ Then how 
about instead of running, you debut as a 
nature UmaTuber?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How about something like, "Ride the Wave: 
Party Animal Camp☆"? Let's go viral and 
aim for that golden hour vibe, y'know~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
UmaTuber! Sounds good! Something like that 
could totally work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We could shoot funny videos set in 
Hokkaido! There are so many project ideas 
we could do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what kind of thing do you think 
would be a hit?

Nature videos... The first thing that 
comes to mind is—
choice_data_list: Till the land and build a farming village

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"A farming village! Should we build a 
Party People Village? Sounds tough, but 
that could be pretty cool too!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy, ayy, ayy, ayyy-yo☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna plow every last inch of it! 
Let's gooo☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bestie, ready for lunch soon? Today it's 
freshly caught salmon for a salmon 
paaaarty!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, like, seriously? My arms are gonna 
get totally jacked★ Are we doing arm 
wrestling instead of races from now on or 
something~?

Just the mere thought of it made me feel 
like I was bulking up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
An endurance contest! That makes sense, it 
gets super cold around here in winter. It 
snows, too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, bestie~... This cold... Isn't it 
legit insane? Should we just count up our 
vibes or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, my vibes are down by 1 chill... now 
down by 2 chills... Oh no, snow bunnies 
are throwing a party night in my head...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
T-That looks pretty tough... But when it 
comes to gutting it out, I've got total 
confidence!

...The level of cold was completely 
different from the area around Tracen 
Academy. It felt like this would build a 
tremendous amount of perseverance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, nature really is wondrous, isn't 
it? When I was a kid, I just thought of it 
as empty nothingness, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all! You can do 
anything if you put your mind to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, what I do in here is entirely up to 
me.)
And so, several days passed—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... It's already morning, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It's so fun, every bit of it. Fishing, 
foraging, cooking, filming videos...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I am free! I can do whatever I want! No 
matter what I do, I can make a living! In 
that case...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What do you really want to do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Close... your eyes... And ask 
yourself...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(What is this feeling welling up inside 
me? If I were free, what would I...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Faint Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: This voice is...
(Whooooosh!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "—The wind. Like the wind—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I... I—will...!!

—I wake up inside the tent. Rubbing the 
sleep from my eyes, I step outside to 
find—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(The breeze feels wonderful. The air 
washes through my lungs, and the morning 
sun... glides across my skin...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I just want to stay like this. Right now, 
I don't need an opponent or a goal line. I 
just... I just...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: As I please, as I desire! Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!

Mejiro Palmer sprinting single-mindedly 
through the morning glow. That sight was—

"It was completely natural, so vibrant, 
and utterly beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...I love it. Running, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fast or slow doesn't matter. When you 
clear your mind and just run—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The nape of my neck gets all tight. And 
then my whole back starts shivering!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't running just now for any 
particular reason. Seeing the scenery 
stretch out before me just made my 
legs—and my heart—move.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm sure of it—I love running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, exactly!

They share a laugh. No further words are 
needed. Mejiro Palmer seems to have 
finally found a piece of her true 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Look, see that? Behind us... 
that's Mount Yotei.

Told to look back, I turn around and see 
the mountains of Mejiro Palmer's hometown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Back then, looking at that mountain kinda 
scared me. It felt like it was telling me, 
'Run properly.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's like... you just feel overwhelmed by 
her presence.
I used to be scared. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, right now it's~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It really is scary, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, I guess I'm not as scared as I used to 
be. Finally. Because—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was able to show my true 
self—even if it wasn't amazing, it was my 
natural running style. That's right—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The reason I ran today was simply because 
'I wanted to run'!
